Ch130 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: complex analysis | ID: 43313

Statement

If A is a positive operator on a Besov space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Step 3. Using the Schatten regularization, we obtain \(A_{01300013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the schematic space.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via complex interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
